assessment: This valuable work explores the influence of intra tumor heterogeneity of neoepitopes within a cancer on the immune response leading to tumor control in vivo using a transplantable murine lung cancer model. It presents convincing evidence that immune responses against weak neoepitopes are enhanced when clonally expressed with strong neoepitopes, due to a more mature DC phenotype and a higher stimulatory capacity of DCs presenting both weak and strong neoepitopes. The work will be of interest to immunologists and cancer immunotherapists.
